root_cause_analysis: Line 58 in 'src/editorial_engine.py' attempts to construct a prompt using a Python f-string (f""") containing unescaped literal curly braces used for JSON structure examples (e.g. '"reality":"..."'). Python's f-string parser interprets the text after the colon as a formatting specifier rather than raw JSON string content, resulting in a ValueError.
actionable_instructions: Escape all literal syntax curly braces in the prompt template in 'src/editorial_engine.py' by doubling them ('{{' and '}}').
Alternatively, move the static LLM prompt template out of an f-string and use standard string formatting or external template files (e.g., Jinja2/text files).
Run unit tests for 'editorial_engine.py' or re-run 'engine.py' with dry_run=true to confirm resolution before restarting production.
